sketch:
Observe: prebuilt schematic with a pile, resistor, and lamp; student
inserts an ammeter by dragging it onto any wire segment (only
series-legal placements light up). HUD displays I in mA; a coloured
"electron flow" animation speeds up as R decreases. Experiment: match
a target current by choosing the correct dipole from a bin. Compare I
at three points to discover I is uniform in a series loop vs. splits
at a node. Evaluate: schematic with ammeters hidden; student predicts
each reading, then reveals. Wrinkle: node-law demo (Kirchhoff current)
as a small parallel branch.
